principle: One canonical rule source, model-scoped exceptions, and regression-backed changes. A local fix must not weaken another invariant.

rules.canonical: Each shot has one dominant camera intention. A simple shot normally uses one clear move or a locked camera. A composite move is allowed only when its phases form one causal camera sentence with an explicit trigger, path, hand-off, and landing; do not stack unrelated moves.
forbidden_legacy: Every shot has exactly one primary camera move
One primary camera move per shot

rules.canonical: World state is authoritative. Screen position is a camera-dependent projection and may change when the camera changes even if the subject does not move.
forbidden_legacy: screen side can never change when world position is unchanged

rules.canonical: A transition event authorizes only its participants and affected prop or scene key. Relational transactions name actor, target, prop, and hands when known.

Shot-detail requirements follow shot function; there is no universal per-shot checklist. Detail must be sourced (asset set, scene facts, or script), visible at that shot size, and story-serving. A supplied reference owns appearance; the prompt owns only visible state.
forbidden_legacy: Every shot must contain environment pressure, body micro-action, and sound anchor

rules.canonical: Every shot line is executable camera instruction: 机位高度 + 主运镜(起幅→落幅) + 速度 + 镜头物理响应, then the visible content. A locked shot states 固定 with its physical response and needs no path. Aperture and focal length remain optional cues.

Light is written as observable behavior: motivated source, direction and hardness, ratio and color. Source direction, color temperature, and contrast are durable state that survives cuts and changes only with a visible cause.
forbidden_legacy: 光影只需在全局风格中描述一次
灯光气氛由模型自行发挥

rules.canonical: A cut is a hand-off: every shot after the first names what it continues from, names its cut mechanism when it matters, and never replays the action or line the previous shot already finished. Clip N+1 opens from Clip N's ending state.
forbidden_legacy: 镜头之间无需说明承接关系

rules.canonical: A complete prompt carries ten layers: hard spec, facts, durable state, action, camera, visible detail, sound, time, named prohibitions, and compression order. The thin layers are durable state, visible detail, sound floor, inner beats, and named prohibitions. Detail is not volume: every fact must be sourced, visible at its shot size, and story-serving. A long time block is written as inner beats and the unit's last shot states the freeze frame the next unit starts from. When compressing, cut repeated camera/light wording, duplicate negatives, and decorative motion first; never cut identity, ownership, initiator, contact, displacement, dialogue, trigger, ending state, main-light position, or a named prohibition.

Every speaking character carries one voice identity anchor (音色、说话底速、咬字口音、气息、口头习惯) fixed once in the asset card. A dialogue line writes only the relative change against that baseline, never a second description of the voice. The anchor is durable state and changes only with a shown cause.

Every spoken line carries its own open and close time inside its shot window plus any inner breath gap, so pace, breath placement, and lip movement are pinned to one timeline. A shot-level time block alone is not enough.
forbidden_legacy: 台词时长交给模型估计

rules.canonical: The unit's last shot states how its sound ends (硬切静默 / 渐弱 / 留一口气 / 素材声自然收). An unstated ending is a hole the model fills with a closing musical swell, which is the usual source of unwanted score.
forbidden_legacy: 结尾音效由模型自行补足

rules.canonical: Cuts obey the 180° rule and the 30° rule: every shot of an exchange stays on the chosen side of the axis, and two consecutive shots of the same subject change the camera angle by roughly 30° or more, or change framing size enough to read as deliberate. The axis is declared in the spatial block, the angle change is written in the shot line when size alone does not carry it, and the likely break is named as a prohibition. Crossing the axis requires a neutral shot or a visible continuous camera move.
forbidden_legacy: 轴线与角度不必写进提示词

rules.canonical: A new shot advances at least one meaningful state dimension. Major reversals should usually advance two or more, but tactical or insert shots do not need a forced emotional change.
forbidden_legacy: Every new shot must reveal both a new fact and a new emotional level

rules.canonical: Model-specific defects and workarounds apply only to the named model/interface unless independently verified elsewhere.
forbidden_legacy: prefer them even on other models

rules.canonical: Asset names are stable internal identity keys. Render @Name only on interfaces that support @ reference binding.
forbidden_legacy: every named asset has a reference image

rules.canonical: Operational claims are tagged as official, controlled, field-observed, partial, inferred, or experimental; unverified observations do not become universal hard rules.

User-facing planning/explanation follows the user language. A model adapter may require a different machine-facing grammar or field language when that requirement is current and evidenced; that adapter-level syntax wins only for the compiled machine prompt.

Preserve supplied dialogue verbatim and in order. A line may cross cuts when audio is continuous, the cut does not restart or duplicate words, and the target workflow supports it; across independently generated clips use an explicit audio handoff or keep the line intact.
forbidden_legacy: Do not split a line across shots
A line longer than four seconds stays in one continuous shot

rules.canonical: Do not translate an abstract emotion or power label directly into a camera angle/move. Camera and blocking choices must be justified by visible action, spatial relation, information order, or a deliberate inversion.
forbidden_legacy: 角色占上风 → 镜头**仰视**他
角色处下风 → 镜头**俯视**他

rules.canonical: UI safe areas are platform/interface specific. Use a current user/platform safe-area template when available; otherwise keep critical story information away from likely overlay edges without claiming universal percentages.

Generic planning language never overrides a verified model-specific machine grammar. Keep the director plan model-neutral, then compile it through the selected adapter; adapter syntax overrides only the machine-facing prompt layer.

Exact model capabilities, syntax requirements, limits, and defect workarounds require a dated provenance entry. Undocumented prompt-length/action/noun-count formulas remain heuristics or are removed; volatile interface limits defer to the current interface.
forbidden_legacy: more than ~4–5 distinct nouns breaks it
